description: Name-order parity between the Rust scan sort (natural_cmp in src-tauri/src/commands/vault.rs) and its TS port (naturalCompare in src/lib/core/filesystem/fs.logic.ts).

Each case lists names in their expected ascending order. Both sides assert that every earlier name compares less than every later one, and that sorting the reversed list gives the expected order back.

cases.name: leading zeros and runs longer than u64
case-insensitive, raw name breaks the tie
cases.note: A.md and a.md tie on the lowercase compare; the raw compare puts uppercase first

cases.name: unicode by code point
cases.note: an astral char (😀) sorts after U+FF5A by code point, before it by UTF-16 code unit

cases.name: multi-char lowercase
cases.note: İ lowercases to i + U+0307, so İx sorts after every i followed by an ASCII letter
